_about: Party holding each seat before the 2026 election, built from archive/119 by scripts/build_live_baseline.py. House: 119th Congress holders; vacancies use the last holder's party. In redrawn states notional_party is the party expected under the new map; flips use it when set, otherwise the 119th holder. Edit a notional_party by hand and set notional_source to "hand" to keep it on the next build.
footnote: In redrawn states, gains and losses compare with the new district's expected party.
